turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have about twenty minutes, Hale. Owen found out about this zero from his phone, in the middle of class. Tell me what you have.
Thanks isn't the point, Hale. Owen learned about the zero from his phone in front of his class. Tell me what the school has that justifies that.
I want to walk you through what I found in the version history.
Go ahead. Tell me exactly what you're looking at: the dates, the times, and whose account made each change.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero be withdrawn and that Owen not be made to sit through this in front of his class again. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position. Nothing was agreed.
What moved her: nothing.
